tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Look up DNS records for a domain name. Useful for questions like 'what's the IP address of example.com', 'who handles email for this domain', 'what is the SPF/DKIM record', or general domain troubleshooting. Returns the matching records with their TTLs.

domain.description: The domain name to look up, e.g. 'example.com', 'mail.google.com'

type.description: DNS record type to query (default 'A'). Common values: A (IPv4 address), AAAA (IPv6 address), MX (mail servers), TXT (text records — SPF/DKIM/verification), NS (name servers), CNAME (alias), SOA (zone authority), CAA (certificate authority).
